coaching.headline: Steady structure pressure decided the game despite trailing on kills, and Legion's sweep after Primal Fangtooth ended at the enemy Core.

flags.text: Legion fucking killed all five enemies after allied Primal Fangtooth and razed the enemy duo inhibitor and Core.
Steel mitigated a game-high 111927 damage and dealt 1072 hero damage per minute against a 613 norm.
Gadget and Khaimera died on mid outside any detected fight before Bayle razed the allied mid outer.
Enemy Fangtooth followed Legion's death at the pit and Maco's on duo; Revenant razed the allied duo outer.

focus.title: Group before Fangtooth and mid
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth and every mid-lane trade, Gadget, Legion and Khaimera group with Steel or Maco first, then siege the nearest enemy structure after each allied pick.

23.4.call: Steel's and Gadget's lanes were already open, and neither has a kill or death credited in this lost fight. Before the next Fangtooth, call one of the two to the pit.

32.1.call: Traded 2-2 after Steel's kill on Dekker, while Genesis Core and the enemy mid inner went allied in the same window. Bayle's kill on Steel in the enemy jungle opened the trade; enter that jungle with a second ally.

35.6.call: Opened a body down with Steel dead, and Legion's four kills across the pit and the allied jungle broke the enemy. After a four-kill fight like this, push straight to the inhibitors again.

7a4dbd05-5549-4063-aa37-35b6041d8ad3: Five kills on four different enemies, including a mid rotation kill on Gideon before allied Fangtooth and the enemy mid outer fell. After an enemy outer falls, repeat that trip.
Two of three deaths came outside any detected fight; the death to Revenant on mid preceded enemy Orb Prime. While Orb Prime is up, trade only beside Gadget or Maco.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Game-high 24409 healing and 21 wards, tied with Dekker for the most placed, with no deaths before minute ten. Hold that ward pace whenever a game runs past Fangtooth.
Zero wards cleared while the enemy cleared eight allied wards, and kill participation sat at 29%. If a sentry is equipped, sweep the Fangtooth approaches before each take.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Credited with four enemy structures: the duo outer, mid inner, duo inhibitor and Core, on 14347 objective damage. Keep finishing inhibitors and the Core as the late-game standard.
Three of four deaths fell outside any detected fight, two to Revenant on duo, and hero damage ran 20% under the norm. Until Revenant shows elsewhere, farm beside Maco.
a219a85e-8f27-4adb-bf19-7c067df3810e: Six deaths ran 60% over the norm, the shit part of this win: three outside any detected fight, three to Scarlett. While Scarlett is unseen, trade inside minion cover.
Credited with the enemy offlane inner, and a duo-lane kill on Revenant preceded Legion razing the enemy duo outer. Once the enemy mid outer is down, keep rotating to duo.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Led all ten players with 22546 objective damage, razed the enemy mid inhibitor and added eight assists. When the next inhibitor opens, lead the siege the same way.
Took 66373 damage, the most of all ten; Scarlett scored the two deaths inside detected fights, both in the enemy half. Near Scarlett, gank with a laner ready.

matchup: Bayle was the lane opponent; Steel killed Bayle on the offlane, and Bayle's one kill on Steel came in the enemy jungle.
Revenant, the enemy's top damage at 40060, runs Terminus lifesteal, and Tainted Guard cuts healing on anyone basic attacking Steel.
Bayle's Dire Howl grants omnivamp and a heal from damage taken, so the Tainted Guard cut also trims Bayle's sustain.
build: Forticus, Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard and Transference stack physical armor, which also feeds Heavy Metal's bonus damage.
Unbroken Will raises both armors briefly when immobilized, an answer to Bayle's Cursed Edge stun and Dekker's Stasis Bomb.
Fist Of Razuul, finished last, empowers a basic attack and heals for half the bonus damage; earlier fights lacked Fist Of Razuul.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health by a percent growing with level and adds size; Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns.
Krix is the only rated Steel offlane Eternal, most played without a claimed edge; Voracity with Cannibalism is the most-played pair.
augment: Heavy Metal adds magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor.
Heavy Metal is the only Steel offlane augment with enough games to rate, so the pick matches the field, edge unclaimed.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's active grows size and max health briefly, damages nearby heroes, then adds permanent max health from that damage.
Razorback and Saphir's Mantle, both Goliath Crest paths, lack the games to rank for Steel offlane: no field pick.
improvement: No field-backed swap: Krix and Heavy Metal are the most-played Steel offlane picks, and no crest ranks yet.
Kit read: Razorback trades the permanent health growth for brief extra armor and reflected hero damage against heavy burst.

matchup: Duo was Legion and Maco against Revenant and Dekker; neither duo lost a player before minute ten.
Dekker's Stasis Bomb stuns and Containment Fence blocks enemy heroes from passing, the catch tools to respect around Legion.
Gideon's and Dekker's Tainted Scepter cut healing on targets taking magical damage, trimming Maco Gift heals on those allies.
build: Tainted Totem cuts healing on targets Maco damages and lends Blighted Touch to healed or shielded allies.
Everbloom grants allies brief damage mitigation and tenacity whenever Maco heals or shields an ally.
Timewarp, finished last, trims non-ultimate cooldowns over time; earlier fights ran without Timewarp.
eternal: No Maco support field sample exists on this patch yet, so the Eternal stays a Kit read.
Kit read: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
augment: Shatterbloom makes Maco Strike leave a healing field at the explosion location.
Kit read: Shatterbloom pairs the ultimate's stun with team healing, matching the healer job Maco filled.
crest: Rift Walkers' active dashes forward and pulls nearby heroes; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
No Maco field crest sample; Kit read: the raised ward cap suits a support placing 21 wards.
improvement: Kit read, no field backing: Tithe of Death swaps Lich's magical lifesteal for mana and ability haste on takedowns.

matchup: Revenant's Reckoning forces one target into the Nether Realm for a duel, the threat facing a carry caught without Maco.
Revenant ran Terminus lifesteal; Legion owned no healing-cut item, while Steel's Tainted Guard and Maco's Tainted Totem covered the cut.
Bayle built Forticus armor; Infernum's Cinder grows with enemy bonus armor and The Perforator ignores a share of physical armor.
build: Malady's Demise adds damage on low-health heroes, and takedowns reset the cooldown, a shape built for chained kills.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Overseer, finished last, boosts Orbital Sanction damage and heals from the ultimate's hero damage; earlier fights lacked Overseer.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by basic attacks for more damage dealt and less damage taken.
Thraex is the only Legion carry Eternal with enough games to rate; the pick follows the field without a proven edge.
Savage Strikes with Rallying Roar is the only Thraex pair with enough games to rate; Alpha's Court with Rallying Roar has three.
augment: Press the Advantage spawns a Rally Point at each takedown, raising Legion's rate of fire and allies' attack speed.
Press the Advantage and Scorched Earth are a toss-up in the Legion carry field, making the pick a sound keep.
crest: Nex's active dashes and hits nearby heroes, growing with Sow stored from recent hero damage, plus a brief slow.
Ortus is the only Legion carry crest with enough games to rate, most played with no edge claimed; Nex has five games.
improvement: Savage Strikes over Alpha's Court matches the only rated Thraex pair: on-hit damage with healing, instead of bonus damage away from allies.
Kit read: Ortus trades Nex's dash burst for speed and power refreshed on takedowns, suited to kill chains like the final sweep.

matchup: Gideon, the mid opponent, killed Gadget twice, first blood included; Gadget killed Gideon once.
Gideon finished Spellbreaker last; once owned, the Veil spell shield blocks the next ability, so lead with Sticky Mine before Security Gate.
Scarlett's Swan Song restrains one target and First Intent dashes through enemies, the jungle threat to track before mid trades.
build: Soulbinder adds bonus damage to abilities hitting heroes from long range, rewarding Sticky Mine and Seek and Destroy poke.
Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power, and Overseer boosts Tesla Dome damage and heals off the ultimate's hero damage.
Timewarp, finished last, arrived with the game nearly over, so no earlier fight had Timewarp.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on casts and gold from ability damage to heroes; Perfection adds ability haste at high health.
Vesh is the only Gadget mid Eternal with enough games to rate, with no edge claimed; Aion is listed, unranked.
augment: Auto-Lock Amp speeds Seek and Destroy's homing toward enemy heroes.
Auto-Lock Amp is the only Gadget mid augment with enough games to rate: most played, with no edge to claim.
crest: Epoch's active enters Stasis briefly, the tool for surviving a committed Scarlett or Revenant dive.
Epoch is the only Gadget mid crest with enough games to rate, so the pick matches the most-played option.
improvement: No field-backed Eternal swap: Vesh leads by games only, so Aion stays a style choice.
Kit read: within Aion, Runic Focus scales magical power with current mana instead of Perfection's haste at high health.

matchup: Scarlett's Tainted Blade cuts healing on physical hits and Gideon's Tainted Scepter on magical ones, both trimming Khaimera's regeneration.
Khaimera's Cull suppresses enemies in a forward cone, the lock for Legion's and Gadget's damage to follow.
Khaimera's only kill was Revenant on the duo lane; Scarlett, the jungle opponent, never fell to Khaimera.
build: Overlord cleaves basic-attack damage around the target, and Sky Splitter adds current-health damage on hits.
Draconum boosts healing while damaging heroes or monsters and restores health on takedowns.
Frostguard, finished last, adds both armors and cuts attack speed of basic attackers; earlier fights lacked Frostguard.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage projectiles on damaging a low-health hero; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after the Ambush leap.
Thraex is the only Khaimera jungle Eternal with enough games to rate, no edge claimed; Weald sits listed but unranked.
Natural Resistance cleanses crowd control at low health; Forage with Wind-Rider is the most-played Weald pair.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, more in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion leads a toss-up with Feral Ambush in the Khaimera jungle field: keep the pick.
crest: Judgement's active damages nearby enemies and heals on hero hits, at half strength for later hero hits.
Iceskorn Talons is the only Khaimera jungle crest with enough games to rate, most played with no edge claimed; Judgement is listed.
improvement: No field-backed swap: Thraex and Iceskorn Talons lead by games only, so no edge over Weald or Judgement is proven.
Kit read: Iceskorn Talons, also a Champion Crest path, trades Judgement's heal for an ice sheet granting allies power and speed.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

revenant.loadout: Lotus (Flawless + Immaculate), augment Spectral Bounty, crest Pacifier

sources.note: random: 27 procs, 1 in 4 is +4 haste (expected value)
sources.how: 27 random bonuses (every 2 min and every takedown), 1 in 4 is +4 haste: about +27 expected

fedBy: Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
lines: Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Revenant touched shortened Reckoning, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 80.3s late); fight right after Reckoning is spent.
Reckoning at rank 3: 110s base, about 80.3s by the end (27% shorter) from 37 ability haste: Alternator 10, Lotus 27.
9 takedowns (5 kills, 4 assists) fed: Lotus (Eternal).
Revenant dealt 40,060 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +282 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Alternator 10, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Legion (level 18: about 117 physical armor, 66 after penetration; took 11,974 physical damage from heroes, 64% of all hero damage they took) and Steel (level 18: about 320 physical armor, 218 after penetration; took 39,817 physical damage from heroes, 78% of all hero damage they took) that is about 31% and 32% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Alternator (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Immaculate (Eternal minor): Gain 10% Damage Reduction above 85% current health.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Flawless: Ability hits on Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 8 (+10% Magical Power), once per cast.; 1,764 healing recorded.

Lesson: Revenant's penetration cut through: Legion took about 31% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 117, about 66 after 22 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Pacifier, Flawless.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Flawless + Immaculate) sits on the same trigger as the items (healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Revenant killed built physical armor (Steel, Maco). Anti-heal on Steel, Maco. We killed Revenant 4 times.
Copy it? Lotus: 55.2% in 927 Revenant carry games, above the hero's 51.3%; this 3-item core: 56.4% in 2,134 games, level with the 56.7% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Revenant's takedowns fed Reckoning: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Reckoning is used.

members.text: Against Enemy Heroes: Basic Attacks and Abilities apply a stack of Scorn. Apply 3 stacks to a Hero to trigger Shell Smash. Scorn can only be applied once per ability.

members.name: Swift Strikes
members.text: After casting an ability, Bayle gains 45% Attack Speed for one attack. Additionally, he automatically starts with the 3rd attack in his Basic Attack chain, but it always deals 20% decreased damage.

stacks.text: 4 effects on one trigger: Augmentation, Sky Splitter, Vyzar Carapace, Swift Strikes.

countered.text: 2 of the 3 players Bayle killed built physical armor (Steel, Khaimera).

copy.text: Too few Bayle offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
